name: targets-list-no-discover-empty

graded_by.test: owed by the E3 U2 plan

description: A principal without target.discover gets 200 with targets empty, not 403: seeing the fleet is a permission (Storage §9), and the answer to a principal who lacks it is the empty list, so a surface that lists targets for every login never has to handle a second refusal. Graded by the U2 plan's test, which is owed.
